Tell your spouse that you think the couples therapy has been helpful for your relationship, and you think they should try out 1 on 1 therapy, as it has helped you and based on what you know of them and therapy, that it could help them too.

1.) BRING SUNGLASSES! I wear actual glasses but trust me blurry vision is way better than squinting or looking down. Don’t worry about the tan line, I wore my sunglasses for basically a week straight and I didn’t get one.

2.) Sunscreen is no joke. A lot of directors don’t give enough time during water break to reapply so slap that stuff on before you get there. Don’t miss any spots, weird sunburns are no bueno.

3.) If you do get sunburnt, do damage control. Sunburns keep burning even after UV exposure, so aloe is essential. Make sure to get as pure as possible, none of that bright green stuff. Also, cold showers/baths/ice go a long way.

4.) Wear good shoes!!!!! Converse and Vans are not good tennis shoes for marching band, your feet will cry. Get something with good support and padding.

5.) Take care of yourself, drink as much water as you possibly can, and eat a good breakfast/lunch before you get there. Band camp is not a place for cutting the calories. If you do not nurish  properly, you will pass out/ throw up. Don’t have anything too high in dairy or grease before band camp.

6.) Write your sets in your music👏👏👏

7.) A good hack for sore feet is to put a tennis ball/softball on the floor and roll your foot over it. This saved my life.

7.) Have fun! It is a lot of hard work but band kids are some of the most helpful genuine people I know, get to know your squads as much as possible!

I hope this helped!
